changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET metadata = replace(metadata, '逻辑建模（SQL）', '高级建模（SQL）'), last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND (name = 'sys.nav.portal.studioSqlModeling' OR metadata LIKE '%"titleKey":"sys.nav.portal.studioSqlModeling"%') AND metadata LIKE '%逻辑建模（SQL）%';
